image:image.image:title: PolyPDF 1.1.3 showing a 1,506.32 square foot hand trace and custom scale controls on the fictional Riverbend Library A-201 plan
image:image.image:caption: Live PolyPDF 1.1.3 dark-mode capture on the PolyPDF-owned fictional Riverbend Community Library A-201 fixture. The workflow was re-verified in PolyPDF 1.3.4 (build 16); the screenshot records the earlier build.
